label: Study ID
instruction: Assign MAP-0001, MAP-0002 ... at inclusion. One ID per study; companion reports share it.

label: Search record IDs
instruction: Deduplicated library record IDs that report this study; separate with ';'.

label: Companion reports
instruction: Other records (theses, data papers, reports) describing the same study; ';'-separated record IDs or DOIs.

label: Citation
instruction: Full reference of the primary report (APA style).

label: DOI
instruction: DOI of the primary report without the https://doi.org/ prefix; blank if none.

label: Year
instruction: Year of the version of record (or of the preprint if no version of record).

label: Publication type
instruction: Choose one.
allowed_values: journal article; conference paper; thesis or dissertation; report or grey literature; data paper; preprint; book chapter

label: Venue
instruction: Journal, proceedings or publisher name as printed.

label: Venue field
instruction: Primary field of the venue (use the journal's stated scope).
allowed_values: remote sensing or photogrammetry; geomorphology or earth surface; cryosphere or permafrost; hydrology; ecology or biogeosciences; soil science; geography or GIS; multidisciplinary; other

label: Language
instruction: Language of the full text.

label: Full-text source
instruction: How the full text was obtained.
allowed_values: open access; institutional subscription; author copy; interlibrary loan; not obtained

label: Coder
instruction: Initials of the person who coded (or verified the pre-fill of) this study.

label: Coding date
instruction: YYYY-MM-DD.

label: Verifier
instruction: Initials of the human who verified every field against the full text.

label: LLM pre-fill
instruction: Record the model name, version and date if an LLM pre-filled fields; else 'none'.

label: Study aim
instruction: Paraphrase the aim in 30 words or fewer.

label: Application domain
instruction: All that apply.
allowed_values: hydrology or soil moisture; snow; active layer or ground thermal regime; ice-wedge or polygon geomorphology; thermokarst or permafrost degradation; palsa or peat-plateau dynamics; carbon or greenhouse-gas fluxes; vegetation or ecology; landform or geomorphic mapping; hillslope or channel processes; DEM or method evaluation; infrastructure or hazards; other

label: Role of terrain variables
instruction: Main role the terrain variables play in the study.
allowed_values: primary object of study; predictor or covariate in a model; stratification or sampling design; process-model input or mesh; validation or reference

label: Region
instruction: All that apply.
allowed_values: USA - Alaska; Canada - Yukon; Canada - Northwest Territories; Canada - Nunavut; Canada - Quebec or Nunavik; Canada - Labrador; Canada - other; Greenland; Svalbard; Norway (mainland); Sweden; Finland; Russia - European; Russia - Siberia or Far East; Iceland; circumpolar or multiple

label: Area rule met
instruction: Which eligibility rule puts the site in scope (protocol section 4).
allowed_values: (a) inside the CAVM extent; (b) tundra or forest-tundra north of 60°N; (c) permafrost landform or tundra in a permafrost zone north of 50°N

label: Site names
instruction: Named sites as reported; ';'-separated.

label: Latitude
instruction: Centroid of the analysed area, decimal degrees (WGS84). Estimate from maps if not stated and note it in J03.

label: Longitude
instruction: As B06; negative west of Greenwich.

label: Analysed extent (km²)
instruction: Approximate area over which terrain variables were computed.

label: Permafrost zone
instruction: As reported; if not reported, take from Obu et al. (2019) and set B10 accordingly.
allowed_values: continuous; discontinuous; sporadic; isolated patches; none; not reported

label: Permafrost zone source
instruction: Where B09 came from.
allowed_values: reported by authors; Obu et al. 2019 map; not determinable

label: Bioclimatic setting
instruction: Choose the best fit.
allowed_values: high Arctic; low Arctic; subarctic or forest-tundra; oroarctic or mountain tundra; boreal permafrost peatland; other

label: Microforms present or studied
instruction: All that apply.
allowed_values: low-centred polygons; high-centred polygons; flat-centred polygons; ice-wedge troughs; hummocks or earth hummocks; tussocks; palsas or peat plateaus; frost boils or mudboils; water tracks; thermokarst pits or ponds; drained lake basins; strings and flarks; other; none specified

label: Number of elevation inputs
instruction: Rows for this study in elevation_inputs.

label: Number of terrain variables
instruction: Rows for this study in variables.

label: Study ID
instruction: Link to studies.study_id.

label: Elevation input ID
instruction: study_id + '-D' + running number.

label: Source type
instruction: Choose one per elevation input.
allowed_values: ALS lidar; ULS (UAV) lidar; TLS; mobile or backpack lidar; crewed aerial photogrammetry; UAV photogrammetry (SfM); satellite stereo photogrammetry; IfSAR or InSAR; GNSS or total-station survey; other

label: Product name
instruction: Named product or acquisition; 'study-specific' if the authors acquired it.

label: Provider
instruction: Who acquired or produced the data.
allowed_values: national or state agency; research programme; commercial vendor; authors' own acquisition; satellite programme; other; not reported

label: Sensor or platform
instruction: Instrument and platform as reported.

label: Acquisition date
instruction: YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM or YYYY; ';' for several.

label: Acquisition conditions
instruction: All that apply.
allowed_values: snow-free; snow-on; growing season or leaf-on; senescent or leaf-off; frozen ground; not reported

label: Point density (pts/m²)
instruction: As reported (ground or all returns; say which in notes). Leave blank for raster-only products.

label: Nominal point spacing (m)
instruction: As reported, if density is not given.

label: Image GSD (m)
instruction: Ground sampling distance for photogrammetric sources.

label: Georeferencing
instruction: How the data were georeferenced.
allowed_values: direct GNSS/INS; ground control points; RTK or PPK; GCPs plus RTK/PPK; provider-controlled; not reported

label: Vertical accuracy (m)
instruction: Numeric value as reported, in metres.

label: Vertical accuracy metric
instruction: Statistic behind C13.
allowed_values: RMSEz; NVA at 95% confidence; VVA 95th percentile; standard deviation; mean absolute error; other; not reported

label: Accuracy basis
instruction: Who assessed it.
allowed_values: provider report; authors' independent checkpoints; both; not reported

label: Surface type
instruction: Surface the terrain variables were computed on.
allowed_values: DTM (bare earth); DSM; DSM adjusted toward bare earth; TIN; point cloud used directly

label: Who built the surface
instruction: Choose one.
allowed_values: provider product; authors, from provider-classified points; authors, from raw points with own classification; not reported

label: Ground filter
instruction: Algorithm or software used to classify ground points.
allowed_values: provider (unspecified); TerraScan; LAStools lasground; PDAL SMRF; PDAL PMF; cloth simulation (CSF); multiscale curvature (MCC); progressive TIN densification; manual editing; other; not reported; not applicable

label: Ground-filter parameters reported
instruction: Are the filter's parameters given?
allowed_values: yes; partly; no; not applicable

label: Gridding or interpolation
instruction: Method used to make the raster from points.
allowed_values: TIN linear; natural neighbour; IDW; kriging; spline; binning - minimum; binning - mean; binning - other; provider (unspecified); other; not reported; not applicable

label: Native cell size (m)
instruction: Cell size of the elevation product as produced.

label: Analysis cell size (m)
instruction: Cell size on which terrain variables were computed (same as D06 if not resampled). ';' for several.

label: Resampling method
instruction: If D07 differs from D06.
allowed_values: none; bilinear; cubic; nearest neighbour; aggregate - mean; aggregate - other; re-gridded from points; other; not reported

label: Hydro-conditioning
instruction: Applied to the surface before terrain analysis.
allowed_values: none; hydro-flattened by provider; depression filling or breaching; stream burning; other; not reported

label: Gap filling
instruction: How voids were filled.
allowed_values: none; interpolation; another DEM; not reported

label: Vertical datum reported
instruction: Is the vertical datum or geoid stated?
allowed_values: yes; no

label: Elevation data availability
instruction: Can the elevation data be obtained?
allowed_values: public archive with persistent ID; public archive without persistent ID; on request; not available; not reported

label: Data identifier
instruction: DOI, URL or archive ID (e.g., InPort, OpenTopography, OSTI).

label: Notes
instruction: Anything that qualifies C and D fields.

label: Study ID
instruction: Link to studies.study_id.

label: Variable ID
instruction: study_id + '-V' + running number. One row per terrain variable per elevation input.

label: Elevation input ID
instruction: Link to elevation_inputs.dem_id.

label: Variable family
instruction: Choose one (see protocol Table 2).
allowed_values: slope or gradient; aspect; curvature; relative position; roughness or rugosity; hydrological or compound; solar or insolation; morphometric classification; microform delineation; spectral, texture or variogram; point-cloud geometry; other

label: Variable name (verbatim)
instruction: Name used by the authors.

label: Curvature type
instruction: Only for curvature rows.
allowed_values: profile; plan; tangential; mean; total or Laplacian; general; other; not reported; not applicable

label: Algorithm (verbatim)
instruction: Algorithm, method or formula exactly as stated; 'not stated' if absent.

label: Algorithm (coded)
instruction: Map E07 to the closest category.
allowed_values: Horn 1981 (3FDWRSD); Zevenbergen-Thorne 1987 (2FD); Evans-Young quadratic (3FD); Wood 1996 multiscale quadratic; Florinsky 2009 5x5; Shary 1995; maximum downhill or D8 slope; Gaussian derivative or scale space; polynomial or plane fit to points; flow routing - D8; flow routing - D-infinity; flow routing - multiple flow direction; difference from focal mean (TPI-type); difference from smoothed surface (residual); geomorphons; other; not reported

label: Algorithm basis
instruction: How E08 was determined. Only 'named by authors' or 'formula given' earn RCI credit.
allowed_values: named by authors; formula given; inferred from software default; not determinable

label: Software
instruction: Software or library that computed the variable.
allowed_values: ArcGIS Desktop; ArcGIS Pro; QGIS (native or GDAL); GDAL (gdaldem); SAGA GIS; GRASS GIS; WhiteboxTools or Whitebox GAT; LandSerf; R - terra or raster; R - spatialEco; R - MultiscaleDTM; R - RSAGA or Rsagacmd; R - other; Python - RichDEM; Python - xarray-spatial; Python - NumPy/SciPy custom; Python - other; MATLAB - TopoToolbox; MATLAB - custom; TauDEM; ENVI; ERDAS IMAGINE; eCognition; LAStools; PDAL; CloudCompare; other; not reported

label: Software version
instruction: Version string as reported, else 'not reported'.

label: Tool or function
instruction: Tool, function or command with options, as reported.

label: Window (cells)
instruction: Neighbourhood as reported, e.g., '3x3', 'circle r=5'; ';' for several.

label: Window or support (m)
instruction: Window width or support in metres; ';' for several.

label: Window (m) basis
instruction: How E14 was obtained.
allowed_values: reported; computed from cells x cell size; not determinable

label: Support type
instruction: How scale enters the computation.
allowed_values: native 3x3 kernel; larger moving window; smoothing then kernel; multiscale quadratic fit; coarser resampled grid; object or segment based; point-cloud neighbourhood; other

label: Multiscale
instruction: Computed at more than one window or resolution?
allowed_values: yes; no

label: Scales (m)
instruction: All windows or resolutions used, in metres; ';'-separated.

label: Pre-processing before the variable
instruction: All that apply.
allowed_values: none stated; explicitly none; smoothing - mean; smoothing - Gaussian; smoothing - median; other low-pass filter; resampling; detrending; depression filling or breaching; not reported

label: Pre-processing parameters
instruction: Window, sigma or other parameters, with units.

label: Units
instruction: Units of the variable as reported.
allowed_values: degrees; percent; m/m; radians; metres; unitless; class; other; not reported

label: Use in the study
instruction: Main use of this variable.
allowed_values: predictor in statistical or ML model; descriptive map or statistic; classification or segmentation input; process-model input; threshold or delineation rule; validation target; other

label: Sensitivity tested for this variable
instruction: All that apply.
allowed_values: none; resolution; window or support; algorithm; elevation source; pre-processing; other

label: Scale rationale
instruction: Why this window or resolution was chosen.
allowed_values: none given; cites literature; matched to feature size; optimised against an outcome; multiscale ensemble; data-driven (variogram or spectral); other

label: Evidence location
instruction: Page or section, plus a quote of 25 words or fewer supporting E07, E10, E13 or E14.

label: Notes
instruction: Anything that qualifies this row.

label: Target microforms
instruction: Only for rows with variable_family = microform delineation.
allowed_values: polygon centres; polygon rims; ice-wedge troughs; hummocks; hollows; tussocks; palsas or peat plateaus; water tracks; thermokarst pits or ponds; other

label: Delineation method
instruction: Choose one.
allowed_values: threshold on a terrain variable; watershed or segmentation; object-based image analysis; machine learning (e.g., random forest); deep learning (e.g., CNN or U-Net); geomorphons; morphological operators; graph-based; manual digitising; other

label: Delineation inputs
instruction: Elevation-derived layers and other inputs used; ';'-separated.

label: Delineation validation
instruction: Reference used to check the delineation.
allowed_values: none; manual reference digitising; field mapping; other

label: Delineation accuracy
instruction: Metric and value as reported.

label: Elevation accuracy assessed
instruction: Highest level of elevation-accuracy evidence in the study.
allowed_values: authors' independent checkpoints; provider report cited; both; none reported

label: Terrain-variable accuracy assessed
instruction: All that apply.
allowed_values: none; field-measured (e.g., inclinometer or survey); higher-resolution reference surface; synthetic or analytical truth; comparison between products; other

label: Uncertainty propagated to variables
instruction: Choose one.
allowed_values: none; analytical; Monte Carlo or stochastic simulation; error surfaces or sensitivity maps; other

label: Vegetation bias
instruction: How vegetation effects on the ground surface were handled.
allowed_values: not addressed; discussed only; quantified; corrected

label: Sensitivity tested (study)
instruction: All computation choices whose effect on results was tested.
allowed_values: none; resolution; window or support; algorithm; elevation source; ground filter or gridding; pre-processing; other

label: Sensitivity outcome
instruction: Authors' conclusion about the tested choices.
allowed_values: not tested; material effect reported; no material effect; mixed or unclear

label: Sensitivity notes
instruction: 50 words or fewer: what changed, by how much.

label: Code availability
instruction: Choose one.
allowed_values: public repository with persistent ID; public repository without persistent ID; on request; not available; not reported

label: Derived data availability
instruction: DTMs or terrain-variable rasters produced by the study.
allowed_values: public with persistent ID; public without persistent ID; on request; not available; not reported

label: Source data identified
instruction: Could a reader find the exact elevation data used?
allowed_values: fully (dataset ID or DOI); partially (name only); not identified

label: Where methods are described
instruction: Choose one.
allowed_values: main text; supplement; earlier paper cited; mixed

label: R01 Elevation source or product identified
instruction: Domain: Data. Judged per elevation input. Score = share of applicable inputs for which every part of the item is reported (main text, supplement, companion record, or a specific cited source documenting the same data or processing).
allowed_values: 0 to 1; NA

label: R02 Acquisition date or year
instruction: Domain: Data. Judged per elevation input. Score = share of applicable inputs for which every part of the item is reported (main text, supplement, companion record, or a specific cited source documenting the same data or processing).
allowed_values: 0 to 1; NA

label: R03 Point density, spacing or GSD
instruction: Domain: Data. Judged per elevation input. Score = share of applicable inputs for which every part of the item is reported (main text, supplement, companion record, or a specific cited source documenting the same data or processing). NA for a named public product with a persistent identifier (the provider documents density).
allowed_values: 0 to 1; NA

label: R04 Vertical accuracy of elevation data (value and metric)
instruction: Domain: Data. Judged per elevation input. Score = share of applicable inputs for which every part of the item is reported (main text, supplement, companion record, or a specific cited source documenting the same data or processing).
allowed_values: 0 to 1; NA

label: R05 Surface type and ground-classification method
instruction: Domain: DTM. Judged per elevation input. Score = share of applicable inputs for which every part of the item is reported (main text, supplement, companion record, or a specific cited source documenting the same data or processing). NA for a provider DTM with a persistent identifier (the authors did no ground classification).
allowed_values: 0 to 1; NA

label: R06 Gridding or interpolation method
instruction: Domain: DTM. Judged per elevation input. Score = share of applicable inputs for which every part of the item is reported (main text, supplement, companion record, or a specific cited source documenting the same data or processing). NA for a provider DTM with a persistent identifier (the authors did no gridding).
allowed_values: 0 to 1; NA

label: R07 Cell size used for terrain variables
instruction: Domain: DTM. Judged per elevation input. Score = share of applicable inputs for which every part of the item is reported (main text, supplement, companion record, or a specific cited source documenting the same data or processing).
allowed_values: 0 to 1; NA

label: R08 Pre-processing before derivatives stated (including explicit 'none')
instruction: Domain: DTM. Judged per terrain variable. Score = share of variables for which the item is reported; for R09 only 'named by authors' or 'formula given' earns credit, not an algorithm inferred from software defaults.
allowed_values: 0 to 1; NA

label: R09 Derivative algorithm named or given as a formula
instruction: Domain: Derivatives. Judged per terrain variable. Score = share of variables for which the item is reported; for R09 only 'named by authors' or 'formula given' earns credit, not an algorithm inferred from software defaults.
allowed_values: 0 to 1; NA

label: R10 Software named
instruction: Domain: Derivatives. Judged per terrain variable. Score = share of variables for which the item is reported; for R09 only 'named by authors' or 'formula given' earns credit, not an algorithm inferred from software defaults.
allowed_values: 0 to 1; NA

label: R11 Software version reported
instruction: Domain: Derivatives. Judged per terrain variable. Score = share of variables for which the item is reported; for R09 only 'named by authors' or 'formula given' earns credit, not an algorithm inferred from software defaults.
allowed_values: 0 to 1; NA

label: R12 Window or support reported (cells or metres)
instruction: Domain: Derivatives. Judged per terrain variable. Score = share of variables for which the item is reported; for R09 only 'named by authors' or 'formula given' earns credit, not an algorithm inferred from software defaults.
allowed_values: 0 to 1; NA

label: R13 Code or derived data openly available
instruction: Domain: Openness. Judged once per study: 1 if code or derived data are publicly available (any public link), otherwise 0.
allowed_values: 0 to 1; NA

label: RCI (total)
instruction: Mean of applicable R01-R13 item scores (computed, not typed).

label: RCI - Data domain
instruction: Mean of applicable R01-R04.

label: RCI - DTM domain
instruction: Mean of applicable R05-R08.

label: RCI - Derivatives domain
instruction: Mean of applicable R09-R12.

label: Uncertain fields
instruction: Field names the coder was unsure about; ';'-separated.

label: Author query
instruction: Question to send the authors; only for studies that tested sensitivity to computation choices or whose data are benchmark candidates (protocol 7.4).

label: Notes
instruction: Free text.
